Private houses expose the delay in a shared task

Verse 4 notes that the people’s own houses are finished and paneled. Verse 9 says each one “is busy with his own house.” The trouble is where their energy goes. Haggai reads their poor harvests as a signal to stop and think. The response is quick. Verses 1 and 15 are dated twenty-three days apart. Ezra 5:1–2 records the same new start.
The smaller building does not end God's presence

Verse 3 says honestly that the new building looks like nothing. Ezra 3:12 shows old men weeping at the sight. Verse 4 does not deny the difference. It says “be strong” three times and then “work.” The reason is God’s presence, not the size of the house. Verse 5 ties that presence to the exodus. Glory is promised for later (verse 9), and the work is for now.
